acceptanceCriteria.text: A census mechanism enumerates all tracked files and fails CI when a non-exempt file matches zero ownership classes.
The exemption list is explicit, documented, and reviewed (not a wildcard).
A mutation test proves introducing an unowned executable/config file fails the new check.
`review-pages/**` (and any other currently-unowned paths discovered by the census) are backfilled into the ownership model.

issue.title: refactor: prove CI path-ownership completeness instead of asserting representative fixtures
